description:
**Your role:** *As a Senior z/OS UNIX & zLinux Integration Engineer, you will spearhead efforts to modernize and integrate our mainframe with contemporary platforms and tools.* Were seeking an **experienced z/OS Systems Engineer** with **expertise in z/OS UNIX System Services (USS)** and **IBM zLinux** (Linux on IBM Z) to drive innovation in bridging mainframe and distributed systems. In this role, you will:

**Design and implement enhancements** to our **z/OS UNIX and zLinux environments** – ensuring robust, secure, and scalable UNIX system services on z/OS and optimizing Linux on IBM Z for enterprise workloads. You will apply best-in-class engineering practices to develop new features, automate manual tasks, and improve the developer experience on the mainframe.

* **Accelerate Modernization** – **Leverage modern interfaces** like **z/OS Management Facility (z/OSMF)**, the **Zowe** framework, and **IBM Wazi** to integrate mainframe systems into **contemporary DevOps and cloud environments**. This includes enabling REST APIs and CLI tools that allow distributed teams and modern applications to seamlessly interact with z/OS resources. You will play a key role in making the mainframe a more **open and agile platform**, bridging the gap between legacy systems and modern development practices.
* **Implement DevOps and CI/CD practices** for mainframe – Work on integrating z/OS with enterprise **DevOps pipelines**, enabling efficient use of mainframe capabilities in continuous integration and delivery processes. Introduce and support tools such as **Git or Ansible** for z/OS automation, and promote the adoption of modern mainframe development environments (e.g., using **Zowe CLI and APIs** for automation; exploring containerized dev/test frameworks like **IBM Wazi** for z/OS).
* **Ensure system interoperability** – Develop and maintain **interfaces between z/OS and distributed (Linux/Unix) systems**, enabling smooth data exchange and process integration. This may involve building secure API layers, cross-platform file sharing (e.g. via NFS or Zowe API Mediation Layer), and connecting mainframe services to cloud or hybrid environments.
* **Operational Excellence** – Integrate advanced **observability** and **monitoring** for USS and zLinux processes, using tools like system logs, **SMF data**, and modern monitoring dashboards (Grafana, Splunk, etc.) to ensure performance and reliability. You will also **provide third-level support** for complex UNIX and Linux-related issues on the mainframe, employing deep problem analysis to identify root causes and permanent fixes.
* **Technical leadership** – As a senior engineer, you will make high-impact decisions regarding our mainframe integration strategy. You’ll present solution designs and roadmaps to **stakeholders and technical leadership**, advocating for improvements that enhance agility and align with business needs. You will collaborate with architects and other senior engineers to design hybrid solutions that leverage mainframe strengths in a modern IT landscape. Furthermore, you will contribute to our culture by **mentoring colleagues** (e.g., in using new tools or approaches) and by sharing expertise in internal forums and guilds.

**Your team:** You’ll be part of the **Mainframe Platform Core Services** crew, working within a specialized **zSoftware** pod. This cross-functional team focuses on evolving the mainframe to support **new interfaces and hybrid-cloud connectivity**. You will closely partner with team members in **Core z/OS Engineering, Middleware (CICS/MQ) Integration, Security, and Cloud Enablement** to develop end-to-end solutions that connect mainframe services with modern platforms. The team operates globally, so you’ll collaborate with colleagues across different regions and time zones, bringing together a variety of skills to modernize our mainframe environment. The working model is agile, emphasizing iterative improvements, quick feedback loops, and continuous learning as we adopt new technologies in the mainframe context.

**Your expertise:** You are a *seasoned mainframe engineer (8–10+ years of experience)* with a blend of **traditional mainframe skills and modern tooling knowledge**. Key qualifications include:

* **z/OS UNIX System Services (USS)** – Advanced knowledge of **UNIX on z/OS** (shell environment, POSIX interfaces, zFS file system management, Unix security model) and the ability to develop and debug programs or scripts running under USS. Experience porting or integrating open-source tools (e.g., Git, Python) onto USS is an advantage.
* **Linux on IBM Z** – **In-depth understanding of zLinux** (Linux running in KVM or LPAR on IBM Z hardware), including system installation, networking, and performance tuning in a mainframe environment. Familiarity with virtualization via **KVM** and concepts like IFL processors, CPU management, and resource sharing on IBM Z is expected.
* **Modernization Tools** – Hands-on experience with or strong knowledge of **modern mainframe tools** such as **z/OSMF** (IBM z/OS Management Facility) for web-based system management, **Zowe** (Open Mainframe Project’s framework for mainframe integration) — e.g., usage of Zowe CLI/Explorer and API mediation for connecting mainframe services with cloud – and **IBM Wazi** for cloud-based mainframe development/testing. Your ability to utilize these tools and frameworks is critical for enabling an **API-driven, cloud-integrated mainframe** environment.
* **Systems Programming & Scripting** – Proficiency in **shell scripting**, REXX, and programming languages like **Python or C/C++** on z/OS or Linux, enabling you to create automation scripts, API endpoints, and system utilities bridging z/OS with distributed systems. Exposure to infrastructure-as-code (e.g., **Ansible on z/OS**) is a plus, emphasizing code-driven system management.
* **Software Maintenance & Configuration** – Solid knowledge of SMP/E, with proven experience in installing, configuring, and migrating new product versions.
* **Networks & Security** – Good grasp of mainframe networking (TCP/IP on z/OS) and **cross-platform security protocols**. Understanding how to manage secure APIs and connectivity between z/OS and external systems (e.g., leveraging encryption, RACF rules for cross-platform access, etc.) is important for safe integration.
* **Performance & Reliability** – Experience optimizing the performance of USS workloads and zLinux instances, including resource allocation, workload balancing, and monitoring of key metrics (like CPU, memory usage on IFLs, network throughput) to ensure stable operations. Familiarity with **mainframe performance tools** and logs (SMF, RMF) is expected.
* **Strategic & Innovative Mindset** – Passion for **modernizing mainframe usage** and staying updated on industry trends (for example, containerization on zLinux, cloud integration, DevOps practices for mainframe). Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and incorporate them into the mainframe environment when beneficial.
* **Communication & Collaboration** – **Excellent English communication skills** are **essential**, enabling you to collaborate effectively with global teams and to clearly present modernization plans to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable in a leadership capacity, coordinating initiatives across different groups, and nurturing a culture where mainframe and distributed teams collaborate seamlessly on hybrid solutions.

**By joining our team as a senior mainframe engineer in any of these roles, you will be empowered to work independently, make critical technical decisions, and visibly shape the future of our mainframe platform** in a dynamic, agile environment. You’ll leverage your deep specialty—be it base z/OS systems, workload automation, or mainframe Unix/Linux integration—to drive high-impact improvements that keep our mainframe systems robust, modern, and aligned with business needs. We value proactive engineering leadership, strong communication, and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation across all these positions. Each role offers the opportunity to take ownership of technical solutions and present them to stakeholders and technology leadership, ensuring your contributions directly influence our organization’s success.

The Position

Large organisations generate and rely on vast amounts of data across their operations. The quality and trustworthiness of that data directly determines whether regulatory and management reports are credible, whether they can be independently assured, and whether the operational, strategic, and financial decisions based on them are sound. Data Foundations is the discipline that makes data trustworthy by defining what data means, how it should be collected and validated, who is accountable for its quality, and how disputes about its interpretation are resolved. To support this, the Global Data and Digital Solutions (GDDS) function is responsible for establishing and operating these critical data foundations across Corporate Strategy, Sustainability Sites (CS).

  

As the Data Analyst and Architect, you will be the senior technical voice in the newly formed Data Foundations and Operations team in charge of transforming Roches extensive site data and business processes into a clear, highly automated, readily usable, and trusted organizational asset. This is a deliberately hands-on senior role: you will decide how the data should be structured, and then go into the source systems yourself to establish whether the design holds. You will bring a strong technical background, excellent communication skills, and a passion for wrangling data to collaborate closely with Business Process teams, Digital Solutions, and Data experts. As the team grows you will set the technical direction for the analysts working alongside you. Together, you will ensure our investments in Data Foundations support a strategic approach, deliver actionable insights, and provide measurable business value. Ultimately, your work will directly fuel high-impact decisions that enhance sustainability outcomes and elevate overall business performance.

The Opportunity

* **Provide Technical Expertise:** Bring to life CSs global data foundation capabilities, contributing to the implementation of the long-term roadmap for master data management, cataloging, access policy management, and data product lifecycle management.
* **Own the Modelling of the Corporate Strategy Data Model:** Bring the draft conceptual and logical model to something defensible - resolving what belongs in it, what does not, and at what granularity. You will work in close partnership with the Data Strategy, Operations and Insights Data Architect, who owns business meaning and domain correctness. **You own modelling craft, grain and structural integrity.** Neither of you overrides the other, and the model does not hold without both.
* **Prove the Design Against Real Data:** Go into unfamiliar source systems yourself to find the real keys and establish whether records can be joined, so that what gets designed is grounded in what the data actually supports rather than in what it ought to contain.
* **Make Every Figure Traceable:** Define how a disclosed figure is traced back to its source, so that an external assurance provider can follow it end to end, treating lineage and evidence as part of the deliverable rather than documentation added afterwards.
* **Map One Fact Base to Multiple Frameworks:** Serve overlapping but non-identical reporting frameworks, including CSRD and ICSR, from a single consistent set of facts.
* **Set the Technical Standard:** Define the modelling, quality and lineage standards the team works to, mentor the analysts working alongside you and raise the technical bar of those around you, and help specify the remaining roles in the team as it grows. Work with the teams assurance specialist to decide how much scrutiny each use case warrants - enough that an externally assured figure holds, and no more than that.
* **Work Across the Boundary:** Partner with the business functions that steward the data - Group Sustainability, Group Finance, Group SHE, Group Compliance, Real Estate Facility Management, and Engineering - and with the IT analytics and Data Platforms teams on the boundary between warehouse data products and what we build on top.

Who You Are

* **Educated and Experienced:** You hold a Bachelors degree in a relevant technical field (a Masters or advanced certifications are advantageous) and bring 8+ years of progressive experience in data architecture, data modelling, or data foundations within a complex, global enterprise. Experience in life sciences/pharma is preferred, and site experience is a plus.
* **A Conceptual and Logical Modeller:** You work above the physical schema. You can explain grain, conformed dimensions and slowly changing dimensions to an engineer, and explain the same model to a business expert in their own language.
* **Still Hands-On:** You are comfortable getting into unfamiliar source systems to find the real keys and prove whether records can be joined - and you have not stopped doing this as you have become more senior. You would rather check a question yourself than wait for someone else to answer it.
* **Experienced with Assured Reporting:** You have built data for reporting that someone external has checked - statutory, financial, regulatory, or sustainability. You understand what it takes for a number to withstand scrutiny.
* **Disciplined About Evidence:** You record what you did and why as you go, not afterwards. You state the limits of a figure rather than leaving them to be discovered, and you can defend it to someone whose job is to challenge it. We expect this of everyone in the team, not only of the assurance specialist - evidence assembled at the end by someone else is the failure we are trying to avoid.
* **A Technical Lead for Others:** You have guided analysts or engineers, set the standard they work to, and reviewed their work without taking it over. You are comfortable being the person others bring a hard question to.
* **Able to Partner With Domain Depth You Do Not Have:** You will work alongside colleagues who understand this business far better than you will for some time, and whose modelling experience is lighter than yours. You can take their domain knowledge entirely seriously while improving the modelling - without treating the two as the same kind of expertise, and without needing to be the one who is right.
* **Strong Communicator:** Much of this role is conversation with stakeholders who know the business deeply and the data to a certain extent. You can hold those conversations without jargon and without condescension.
* **Comfortable with Ambiguity and Disagreement:** Some of the problems have yet to be fully defined and the scope is currently in evolution. You will frequently be the person stating the uncomfortable truth, with evidence behind it.
* **Also Valuable:** Master and reference data management; metadata and catalog tooling, particularly Collibra; Snowflake; dimensional modelling at scale; Git-based workflows, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.

  

Experience in sustainability, Safety, Health and Environment (SHE), site operations or a regulated reporting environment would be an advantage.

  
Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100 000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let s build a healthier future, together.

title: Manager Strategic Forecasting
description:
### Job Summary

Position Overview: We are leveraging analytics and technology as we invent for life on behalf of patients around the world. We seek colleagues who are passionate about combining data, analytics, business judgment and insight to improve decisions across the end-to-end commercialization process, from business development and pipeline planning through launch and late lifecycle management.

Market Access, Insights and Forecasting (MAIF) is a global capability responsible for long-range pharmaceutical asset forecasting across Human Health, including Oncology, Vaccines, Hospital, Specialty and Primary Care. The portfolio spans early- and late-stage clinical assets, business development opportunities and launched products. Forecasting deliverables inform planning and decisions across commercial, finance, manufacturing, supply, research and development, and country teams. In addition to delivering high-quality forecasts, the team advances methods, standards and reusable solutions that bring greater rigor, speed, consistency and scalability to decision-making.

We are seeking a Manager, Strategic Forecasting who brings strong foundational forecasting capability, analytical curiosity and effective stakeholder partnership. The role will be responsible for delivering forecasts within an assigned therapy area or portfolio, contributing insights to business decisions and improving forecasting approaches under the guidance of senior forecasting leaders. The individual will also explore practical uses of advanced analytics, automation and AI, while keeping sound forecasting methodology, transparency and human judgment at the center of the work.

### Primary Responsibilities

* Support one or more therapy areas or assets, developing strong knowledge of the disease area, product, market, competitive environment and key business questions.
* Build and deliver high-quality strategic forecasts using fit-for-purpose qualitative, epidemiology-based, patient-based, demand-based and statistical approaches.
* Translate defined business questions into structured forecast frameworks, assumptions and scenarios, seeking guidance for highly ambiguous, novel or enterprise-level questions.
* Develop and maintain forecast models, including patient flows, market and share assumptions, analogs, launch curves, scenarios, sensitivities, risks, opportunities and uncertainty ranges.
* Apply pharmaceutical and commercial judgment to identify important forecast levers, test assumptions and ensure models are transparent, appropriately simple and aligned to the decision need.
* Partner with Commercial, Finance, Market Access, Manufacturing, Supply and country stakeholders to gather inputs, reconcile perspectives and build robust assumptions.
* Communicate forecast outputs clearly, highlighting key drivers, uncertainties and business implications. Escalate material risks, unresolved assumptions and decisions requiring senior input.
* Deliver forecasts and analyses on time, with strong quality control, documentation, version management and adherence to agreed processes and governance.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of forecasting methods, templates, scenario planning, range forecasting, documentation and performance monitoring.
* Contribute emerging ideas and informed perspectives on forecasting practices, bringing relevant external methods or examples into team discussions and helping translate them into practical improvements.
* Participate in peer reviews and communities of practice, share lessons learned and support consistent forecasting standards across the team.
* Use AI, machine learning and automation selectively to support forecasting activities such as research and synthesis, analog identification, data preparation, event monitoring, scenario exploration and repeatable workflow steps.
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, traceability and business plausibility. Retain ownership of forecast logic and assumptions and escalate limitations or risks appropriately.
* Identify potential AI or automation use cases within assigned work, support pilots with senior or technical colleagues, and document whether the solutions improve quality, speed or user experience.
* Apply or build working knowledge of analytical techniques such as Monte Carlo simulation, range forecasting, analog analysis, conjoint approaches, clustering, natural language processing and other advanced methods where relevant.
* Contribute to standardization and automation of models and processes while maintaining flexibility for asset- and market-specific needs.
* Support capability building by sharing methods, documenting good practices and providing day-to-day guidance to junior colleagues where appropriate.

### Qualifications and Skills

* Postgraduate degree in business, engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, economics, statistics, data science or a related discipline.
* 3+ years of relevant experience, including meaningful hands-on exposure to pharmaceutical strategic forecasting, commercial analytics or a closely related decision-support role.
* Working knowledge of core pharmaceutical forecasting, including forecast framework design, epidemiology and patient flow, market and share assumptions, analogs, launch curves, scenario and sensitivity analysis, uncertainty and range forecasting.
* Working understanding of pharmaceutical development and commercialization, including clinical development, regulatory milestones, market access, competition, manufacturing, supply and lifecycle management.
* Ability to develop an informed point of view, ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions constructively and translate analysis into clear recommendations within the assigned scope.
* Demonstrated curiosity about evolving forecasting methods and evidence of contributing ideas, reusable approaches or process improvements. Enterprise-wide thought leadership is not required at this level.
* Working knowledge of Monte Carlo simulation and range forecasting; exposure to other advanced forecasting or modeling methods is advantageous.
* Practical awareness of how generative AI, machine learning and automation can support forecasting. Experience applying these tools in analytics workflows is preferred, but deep AI engineering expertise is not required.
* Ability to recognize common limitations of analytical and AI-enabled methods, including data quality, validation, explainability, bias, confidentiality and responsible use, and to seek expert guidance when needed.
* Strong analytical problem-solving skills, attention to detail and comfort working through ambiguity with appropriate support.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and geographies and to manage multiple deliverables and timelines.
